name: JetBrains IDE MCP Server
description: Connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other MCP clients to IntelliJ-based IDEs to build, lint, refactor, run, and search code with IDE tools.

skills.name: Build Project
skills.description: Builds the whole project or chosen files in the IDE, waits for it to finish, and returns compilation errors and warnings.

skills.name: Lint Files
skills.description: Analyzes project files with IntelliJ inspections and returns each problem with its severity, description, and line location.

skills.name: Rename Symbol
skills.description: Renames a variable, function, or class and updates every reference across the project, unlike a text find-and-replace.

skills.name: Run Configuration
skills.description: Runs an existing IDE run configuration, or a temporary one created from a file and line, then waits for it to finish.

skills.name: Run Terminal Command
skills.description: Executes a shell command in the IDE's integrated terminal and returns its output, asking for confirmation unless brave mode is on.
